eyebrow: Built for an organization, starting with one operator
headline: For people delegating outcomes across several agent roles.
lede: The reference implementation starts with one operator. The design extends toward several accountable people without replacing the organizational model.

items.label: Good fit
items.title: Your agents already have different jobs
items.body: Research, building, review, operations, and communication need distinct responsibilities and handoffs.

items.label: Good fit
items.title: Authority cannot remain implicit
items.body: Some work should advance alone; consequential actions should stop with the right person and enough context to decide.

items.label: Not the job
items.title: You only need a per-run workflow
items.body: If one process can route a few model calls and then disappear, a conventional orchestration framework is enough.
